title: FBI-UAP-D020, Digital Rendering, Narrative Statement 2-5, Western United States Event, 2023

pages.description: A nighttime desert or hilly landscape rendered in a dark blue palette with a star-filled sky. In the foreground stand two human silhouettes seen from behind, outlined with a faint yellowish glow; the left figure is taller and appears to wear a jacket and jeans, while the right figure is shorter. Both face away toward the horizon. Along the horizon over the ridge of low mountains there is a horizontal row of four glowing red-orange dots and, at the far right, a single larger round yellowish glowing orb resembling the moon or a bright light. The lower portion of the image shows rocky terrain and dark ground.

observations.claim: Two human silhouettes stand in the foreground viewed from behind
There are four red glowing dots in a horizontal line near the horizon
A larger yellowish round glowing orb appears at the far right of the horizon
The sky is dark blue and filled with numerous small white stars
A low mountain ridge separates the sky from the darker foreground terrain
The two figures are outlined with a faint yellow-green glow
